pages.text: Formation Runes are used to alter the stats provided by a formation to whitelisted players. $(br)Generator runes create formation energy, $(br)System Cultivation Speed runes consume energy to increase a systems cultivation speed, $(br)System Energy Regen runes consume energy to increase a systems energy regeneration rate. When the formation active it's stats are visible in the Introspection menu.
Runes can be recycled back into their base block form through the smelting them in the furnace.
